analyst_view.overall: Early view: Kauno Zalgiris are bottom with no points and one goal for, 11 against, after defeats by Brighton (4-0), Brann (4-1 at home) and Lugano (3-0). Riga have drawn all three games 1-1, against Kairat, Pafos and Jablonec. I found no domestic news for either club, so this rests on European form.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. Kauno Zalgiris concede a lot, but those goals came against much stronger sides, and Riga have scored only once in each of their games. The two pull in opposite directions, so I stay with the number.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners. I read nothing about either side's style that moves this, so I stay with the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards. Kauno Zalgiris need a first point and Riga need a first win, but neither side's games so far have produced red cards and no referee is known yet, so I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.9 shots, split fairly evenly. Kauno Zalgiris will want to attack at home after three defeats, which supports their share, but Riga have played compact, low-scoring games. Nothing clear points either way.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target. With little news on either side, I stay close to the number.
